purpose: Minimal input contract for private 2D dental image segmentation training in the DentalClaw platform MVP.

private_train.reason: Supervised segmentation training requires paired image-mask labels.

inference_or_qc.reason: Images-only packages can be audited or inferred with a registered model, but cannot produce supervised training metrics.

also_detected_layouts.name: flat_dicom_images_only
also_detected_layouts.description: DICOM files stored directly under the dataset root. This is valid for audit/inference planning, but not sufficient for supervised training.

patient_identity: Optional metadata.json patient_ids maps split/case_id to patient ID; absent mapping means independence is not established.
